chapter.verse: “Sanggamte leh pate aw, tu-in note' mai-a kong gen ding mawhloh lahtelna thu hong thudon dih un,” ci hi.
Hebrew-kam tawh Paul in amaute a hopih a zak uh ciangin mihonpi gamdai semsem hi. Tua ciangin Paul in hih bangin gen hi:

“Kei pen Jew mi ka hi a, Cilicia gamke Tarsus khua-a suak ka hih hangin hih khua ah a khangkhia ka hi hi. Tuni-a note khempeuh danin Pasian' ading thalawp ka hih manin a ngat mahmah i pupite' thukhun tawh kizui-in Gamaliel' khe-phung ah pilna ka sin hi.
Sih nading zah dongin Lampi Thu ka bawlsia a, pasal numei kuamahpeuh kol bulhin thong ah ka ap hi.

Siampi lianpenpa leh makaipawl bup in zong hih keima' thu teci pang thei ding uh hi. Damascus khua-a Jew mipihte' ngahding laikhakte amau' kiangpan ka ngah a, tua taka om thu-umte gawtna piak nadingin amaute kol bulhin Jerusalem a ciahpih dingin ka va pai hi.
“Khualzin lampai-in Damascus khua ka tun kuan, sunkim pawlin vantung pan khuavak a pha mahmah khat ka kimkot ah thakhat thu-in hong taang hi.
Tua ciangin lei ah ka puksuk a, ‘Saul, Saul aw, bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam?’ ci-a hong hopih awging khat ka za hi.
Kei zong, ‘Topa, kua na hi hiam?’ ka ci hi. Amah in, ‘Nong bawlsiatpa Nazareth khuami Jesu ka hi hi,’ hong ci hi.
Ka tonpihte in khuavak a muh uh hangin kei hong hopihpa' awging a kitelin za lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin, ‘Topa aw, bangci hih ding ka hi hiam?’ ci-in ka dot leh Topa in, ‘Tho inla, Damascus khuasung pai in. Tua takah nangma' sep dinga kisehsa khempeuh hong kigen ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua khuavak a leng luatna hangin khuamu nawnlo ka hih manin ka tonpihte in khut tawh hong len uh a, Damascus khua ka tung uh hi.
“Tua khua ah thukhun tawh kituakin thuzui citak, tua khua-a teeng Jew mi khempeuh in zong a phat uh, Ananias cih khat om hi.
Amah kei' kiangah hong pai-in ka gei-ah hong din kawmin, ‘Sanggam Saul aw, khuamu ta in,’ hong ci hi. Tua hunlenai lianin khuamuhna ngahin amah zong ka mu pah hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, ‘I pupite' Pasian in ama' deihna a thei ding, Midikpa a mu ding leh ama' kam pan awging a za dingin nang hong seh khinzo hi.
A hang pen na muhsa leh na zaksa thute tawh kisai-in mi khempeuh' tungah ama' teci na hiding hi.
Tu-in bang ngak na hi hiam? Tho inla ama' min tawh thungen in. Kibaptize inla na mawhnate kisawpsiangsak in’ hong ci hi.
“Jerusalem ah ciahkikin biakinnpi sungah thungetna ka neih laitak mumang bangin ka om a,
‘Kinawh in. Jerusalem pan manlangtak paikhia in. A hang pen amaute in keima' thu na teci panna taksang lo ding uh hi,’ ci-in hong hopih Topa ka mu hi.
Tua ciangin ke'n zong, ‘Topa aw, vengkhawm inn khatkhit khat pai-in nang hong um mite thong denna-in ka vuak lam amau mahmah in thei uh hi.
Nangma' teci Stephen a sisan a buak lai-in keimahmah zong a gei-ah dingin ka thukimpih a, amah a thatte' puantungsilh teng ka na kepsak hi,’ ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, ‘Pai in. A hang pen Gentile mite' kiang gamlapi ah nang kong sawl ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” ci hi.
Mihonpi in Paul' thugenna limtak ngai uh hi. Himah taleh tu-a thu a tun ciangin a awte sangkhan uh a, “Hih bang mihing leitung pan hemkhiasiang un! Amah hingkhawihuai lo hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua bangin mite awngin a puante uh lawnto-in huihlak ah leivui a theh uh ciangin
tul-uk mangpa in mite hizah-a Paul langpangin a ot ngeingaina uh a hang a theihkhiat nadingin galkap len sungah Paul paipih ding leh satna tawh dottel dingin thupia hi.

Ahih hangin savun khauteep tawh sat dingin a khut a hen uh ciangin Paul in a gei-a ding galkap za-uk bupa' kiangah, “Mawhmat thudot om lo pi-in Rome gammi khat na sat ding thukhun tawh a kituak mah hiam?” ci hi.
Hih thu za-uk bupa in a zak ciangin tul-uk mangpa' kiangah pai-in, “Bang a sawm na hi hiam? Hih mipa Rome gammi ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tul-uk mangpa zong Paul' kiangah pai-in, “Hong gen dih in. Rome gammi na hi hiam?” a cih ciangin Paul in, “Ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Tul-uk mangpa in, “Hih gammi suahna pen sum tampi pia-a ka ngahkhiat ahi hi,” a cih ciangin Paul in, “Kei ka hihleh gammi khat-a piang ka hi hi,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin thu dongtel dinga kisa teng ama' kiangpan manlangtak nungkin pah uh hi. Tul-uk mangpa zong Paul, Rome gammi ahihlam leh tua bang mi khat a mankha ahihlam a kitheih ciangin patau mahmah hi.

Himah taleh tul-uk mangpa in Paul tunga Jew mite' ngawhna a hang taktak thei nuam ahih manin a zingciangin Paul a kikhihna phelin siampi liante leh Sanhedrin bup kimuhkhop ding thupia hi. Tua ciangin Paul paisukpihin amaute' mai-ah dingsak hi.
